findings.title: Container writes to a read-only volume
findings.cause: container web exits because it writes to /etc/app/app.conf, which is read-only: ConfigMap app is mounted at /etc/app, and the kubelet always mounts a ConfigMap volume read-only; its log says: "sh: can't create /etc/app/app.conf: Read-only file system"; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container web's log (current run)
evidence.detail: sh: can't create /etc/app/app.conf: Read-only file system

evidence.what: container web mounts volume config (ConfigMap app) at /etc/app

findings.fix: Write to a writable volume instead: mount an emptyDir for the files the app changes, and copy what it needs from ConfigMap app into it with an init container.
